abstract: We present a case of bilateral struma ovarii which developed postoperatively and was histopathologically diagnosed after the patient was hospitalized for investigation and treatment of tumoral anexal bilateral formations. There was no evidence of clinical malignancy or metastases. Data from the literature, together with histopathologic, diagnostic and therapeutic aspects of the disease were checked again taking into account the scarcity of this lesion, especially bilaterally.
abstract_ja: 入院中の両側付属器腫瘤の精査後に術後に発見された両側卵巣甲状腺腫の症例を報告する。組織学的に確認された。臨床的な悪性所見や転移は認められなかった。本疾患のまれさ、特に両側性であることの希少性を考慮し、文献データとともに本疾患の診断、組織学的、治療的側面を再検討した。
